purpose: Frozen untuned benchmark protocol; this document contains no performance results.

statistics.median: arithmetic mean of the two central sorted samples when n is even; central sample when n is odd
statistics.p95: sorted samples, zero-based rank 0.95*(n-1), linear interpolation between adjacent ranks

timing_semantics.external_wall_s: host monotonic clock around process creation, execution and successful exit, including config load, allocation, transfers, encoding and disk output
timing_semantics.production_kernel_event_ms: sum of per-chunk CUDA event elapsed milliseconds in gpu_execution.json; production physics/control kernel only, not the probe kernel or a complete campaign wall time
timing_semantics.gpu_execution_h2d_ms: existing production initialization/allocation/upload interval; not pure PCIe transfer time
timing_semantics.gpu_execution_d2h_ms: existing host waits for state/trace copy events; not pure D2H transfer time
timing_semantics.gpu_execution_host_encode_ms: existing trace-slot host copy/record preparation, not complete output serialization
timing_semantics.gpu_execution_output_ms: existing CPU-compatible result writing interval, excluding final gpu_execution.json close
timing_semantics.gpu_execution_wall_ms: existing device-loop interval after initialization and before result writing; not end-to-end
timing_semantics.stage_overlap_note: GPU chunk copies and kernels overlap; h2d/d2h/encode/output/wall fields must not be summed to reconstruct external wall time.

run_order: for each count ascending: all applicable warmup rounds interleaved by fixed mode order, then all measured rounds interleaved by fixed mode order; every command and ordinal recorded
correctness_policy: Each successful campaign must complete every instance without failure; its semantic result is checked before a measured sample is accepted. Formal CPU/GPU parity remains guarded by M8-A2/A3 and later M8-G.
output_policy: New build/m8_b2_* or build/m8_b3_* root and new tracked receipt only; never overwrite a previous run, partial output or PASS receipt.
performance_claim_policy: M8-B2/B3 publish raw untuned samples and statistics only; speedup and threshold verdicts belong to M8-C3/M8-H3. M8-A diagnostic wall times are not benchmark samples.
